transcript: Nurse: Sir, the doctor is currently with another patient, but he'll be free in around 10 minutes. In the meantime, if there's anything you need, please let me know. Simple, with proper training. And that's why today many hospitals and clinics are using SpeakX Healthcare. This is an AI-powered communication training platform specially designed for healthcare staff. Here, nurses, front desk executives, and hospital support staff practice according to real hospital situations. So if you want to build a confident and professional healthcare team, try SpeakX Healthcare.]
